rule5_boundary_check.rule: Crackers Category Constitution v1 Section 1.1: route to a borderline sub-pool / hold for separate ruling if fat <2g/100g AND ingredient_count <=2 (near-zero-fat, near-zero-ingredient generic puffed rice).
rule5_boundary_check.method: Computed fat_g/100g and top-level-comma ingredient count from the raw BSIP0 scrape for all 36 candidates.
rule5_boundary_check.result: 0/36 candidates trip the boundary flag — CONFIRMED by Nutrition Agent, WITH A CORRECTION to the original reasoning below.
rule5_boundary_check.correction_2026_07_05_nutrition_agent: Original draft claimed the two sub-2g-fat SKUs (7296073161479 fat=1.8g, 7290112348999 fat=1.6g) carry 'long, multi-item ingredient lists.' WRONG — that was a comma-count artifact from splitting UN-cleaned ingredients_raw, which still has the retailer's nutrition-table text run on directly after the real ingredient list (no separator in the pre-BSIP1 dump). Nutrition Agent's independent read of the true declared ingredients for both: 'תירס 99%, מלח, מתחלב (לציטין סויה)' / 'תירס (99%), מלח, מתחלב (לציטין סויה)' — corn, salt, soy lecithin. That is 3 ingredients, not a long list — it clears the Rule-5 <=2 threshold by exactly one item. The AND condition (fat<2 AND count<=2) still never holds for either SKU, so the 0/36 disposition is unchanged, but the record must state the real reason: 3 ingredients > 2, not 'long/complex list.' Action taken: ingredient counts for admission decisions must be computed from bleed-cleaned ingredients_text_he (same clean_ingredients_bleed() cutter used in build_crackers_bsip1.py FIX1), never from raw pre-parse text — this applies at BSIP1 build time for the full 34-candidate batch, not just these 2.
rule5_boundary_check.single_ingredient_natural_fat_note: Nutrition Agent also flagged (informational, not a rule change): several candidates are genuinely 1-ingredient whole-grain products with fat >2g purely from natural bran oil (e.g. 100% brown rice, 100% organic buckwheat) — real fat, but incidental to grain content, not an added-oil architecture like KRIT/Osem. Does not trip Rule-5 (fat is not <2g) and needs no new rule; Bari's existing single-ingredient matrix-integrity handling already covers it honestly. Noted so it is not later mistaken for a Rule-5 near-miss.
